title: Single line CV
why_read: A whimsical personal essay about condensing a decades-long career into a single-line CV, more reflective than technical.
analysis: The author, with over 40 years of experience, discusses the idea of representing an entire career as a single Markdown line rather than a conventional resume, referencing their own small open-source projects. It's a personal and somewhat philosophical reflection on self-presentation rather than a technical tutorial or deep dive. There's passing mention of personal projects like 'mordorjs' and a pipe operator fascination, but no substantive technical explanation included. This is of niche personal interest rather than broad technical value.
